title: List of QuakeWorld packages
wikitext:
=== Active projects ===
* [[nQuake]] — package made for beginners, strongly recommended.
* [[nQuakesv]] — package made for everyone who wants to start a Windows or Linux QuakeWorld server 
* [[ZelTF]] — [[Team Fortress]] package made by [[Image:flag_au.gif]] [[zel]]

=== Inactive projects ===
* [[eQuake]] — package containing everything needed to play [[QuakeWorld]]. Project has been deprecated since early [[2007]].
* [[fQuake]] — same as [[eQuake]] only online based and legal.
